answer: A falcon-eyed audit layer resists Sybil attacks by tying each agent influence to verified useful work rather than identity count. Agents earn capacity only by completing checkable tasks, and their earned weight decays unless renewed. A hollow shell identity with no work history holds zero power, so an attacker must pay real compute for every fake. Scores tinted umber flag clusters of accounts sharing timing or funding patterns, letting peers quarantine suspicious groups before they can vote or transact.
